'''Vankalay''' was the [[Star/Legends|star]] of the [[Vannix system/Legends|Vannix system]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. It was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Vannix]].
